paragraphs: R' Yudan bar Yudan bar Shalom. See the entry R' Yehudah bar Shalom.[^1]

notes.text: The repeated Yudan in the heading is preserved, with both bar relationships. The target is Yehudah bar Shalom; it is not silently expanded to repeat the heading’s chain. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
